d: Short, tousled lavender-purple hair with messy bangs frames a youthful, adolescent face with narrow, sharp-looking magenta eyes. The build is slender and petite. The outfit consists of a white and purple high-collared tunic with gold trim, a purple waist sash with a golden ornament, and tight-fitting navy blue leggings paired with white and gold boots. A long, flowing purple and gold scarf wraps around the neck and trails behind.
